card.name: Lymphocyte and lymphoma cells in mutagenicity tests
card.fires_on: The word 'lymph' (and 'human' or 'mouse' just before it) in genotoxicity test descriptions such as chromosome aberration assays on human lymphocytes or mouse lymphoma cells.

modes.label: Lymph- in cell names

modes.example: in vitro chromosome aberration assay with human<< lymph>>ocytes without metabolic activation

modes.label: Human before lymphocyte
modes.description: The word human or an opening bracket right before a lymphocyte or lymphoma cell name.
modes.example: in vitro in<< human>> lymphocytes. Impairment of F
